fieldValues.title: srs#658 (stale versioning-cell-allowlist entry) currently keeps validate-all.mjs and check-release-drift.mjs red on every PR
fieldValues.summary: scripts/versioning-cell-allowlist.json's one entry (srs/package/metamodel/fields/value_range.json) no longer matches an observed violation, which check-versioning-cell.mjs treats as a hard failure ('shrinking this file IS the fix'). check-release-drift.mjs runs validate-all.mjs as its own first step, so this single stale entry fails both required gates identically, for any PR, regardless of what that PR actually changes. Confirmed pre-existing: reproduces identically on a clean origin/master checkout (commit bc18336) with none of srs#690's changes applied.
fieldValues.rationale: srs#690's PR will show validate-all and check-release-drift red for this reason alone; every check specific to this unit (check-spec-coherence, check-publication-reachability, check-spec-language, srs repo validate, the heading-set diff) is clean. Fixing srs#658 is a separate Door (its own allowlist entry names the real root cause: gen-metamodel-package.mjs's fieldFile() hardcodes version:1 with no per-field override) and was left untouched here as out of scope. The next unit that opens a PR against this branch point will hit the same red gates until srs#658 lands or the entry is otherwise resolved — worth fixing before, or alongside, whichever unit next needs a clean validate-all run.
